title: Renew in person
summary: Bring your driver's licence to an Alberta registry agent to renew. Check the official guidance for any additional documents or medical forms before your visit.
nextStep: Read Alberta's renewal instructions, then contact a registry agent to confirm what to bring. This app cannot renew your licence.
sourceTitle: Renew or replace a driver's licence

title: Check online renewal availability
summary: At the last source review, Alberta.ca said online driver's licence renewal was temporarily disabled. This saved guidance cannot confirm whether that is still the case.
nextStep: Check the official renewal page for current online availability. If it is unavailable, contact a registry agent about renewing in person.
sourceTitle: Renew or replace a driver's licence

title: Prepare your documents
summary: Have your driver's licence ready. Check whether you need to bring proof of legal entitlement; the official page lists accepted original documents and health-card guidance for the integrated card.
nextStep: Review the official document requirements and confirm your checklist with a registry agent. Do not enter or upload personal documents in this demo.
sourceTitle: New driver's licence and identification cards

title: If your licence has expired
summary: It is illegal to drive with an expired licence. Alberta.ca describes additional identification requirements or testing depending on how long the licence has been expired.
nextStep: Read the expired-licence section of the official renewal page and contact a registry agent. This demo cannot decide which requirements apply to you.
sourceTitle: Renew or replace a driver's licence

title: Find a registry agent
summary: Alberta.ca provides a registry finder for registration, information, and licensing services. This demo does not know which office is nearest to you or currently open.
nextStep: Open the official finder and contact your chosen office to confirm hours and renewal services. No address or location sharing is needed in this demo.

title: Check renewal fees
summary: The official renewal page links to the Registry Agent Product Catalogue for maximum renewal charges. This demo does not quote a price or take payment.
nextStep: Use the cost section on Alberta's renewal page and confirm the fee with your registry agent.
sourceTitle: Renew or replace a driver's licence

title: Ask about special renewal situations
summary: Alberta.ca describes remote renewal when temporarily outside Alberta or medically homebound, and situations requiring a medical form. A registry agent can explain the applicable process.
nextStep: Read the relevant section on the official renewal page and contact a registry agent. Do not share medical or immigration details in this demo.
sourceTitle: Renew or replace a driver's licence
